About This Vintage

This is a historical reconstruction of The Budget Lab's "State of U.S. Tariffs: August 7, 2025" report, restructured to match the current interactive's data format.

figures.body_html:
Summary

This section presents projected effects as of August 7, 2025. Estimated impacts are measured against a January 2025 tariff-policy baseline.

spec.title: Average Effective Tariff Rate by Trading Partner
spec.subtitle: As of August 7, 2025, pre- and post-substitution. Percent.
spec.source: Census Bureau, GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.

spec.title: Average Effective US Tariff Rate, New 2025 Policy through August 6
spec.subtitle: Contribution to the increase in the US average effective tariff rate from new 2025 tariffs, by trading partner. Pre- and post-substitution.
spec.source: Census Bureau, GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The average effective U.S. tariff rate by trading partner as of August 7, 2025, before and after trade substitution. Shown here as both a table and a stacked bar chart, with China, Canada, Mexico, and Rest of World stacking to the total for each substitution basis.

spec.title: Consumer Price Effects, Selected Commodities
spec.subtitle: Percent change in producer/consumer prices, short-run and long-run.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: Short-run and long-run price effects for the commodities with the largest projected changes.

spec.title: Household Cost of Tariffs by Income Decile
spec.subtitle: Tariff burden by household income decile, post-substitution.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], Census, BLS, BEA, The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The tariff burden by household income decile, as a share of after-tax income and in dollars per household. Values are negative by convention.

spec.title: Effect on Real GDP over Time
spec.subtitle: Percent change in the level of real GDP versus baseline.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The projected path of real GDP relative to a no-new-tariffs baseline, by quarter.

spec.title: Long-Run Change in Real GDP by {dimension}
spec.subtitle: Percent change in the level of real GDP versus baseline.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The long-run change in real GDP, by sector or by trading partner.

spec.title: Net Revenue Impact by Fiscal Year
spec.subtitle: Billions of dollars.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.
spec.notes: Estimates are net of the offsetting reduction in income and payroll tax revenue.

spec.title: Net Revenue Impact by Fiscal Year
spec.subtitle: Conventional and dynamic estimates. Billions of dollars.
spec.notes: Estimates are net of the offsetting reduction in income and payroll tax revenue.

figures.body_html: The net federal revenue impact of the tariffs by fiscal year, on a conventional and a dynamic basis.
